title: The action picks one Xor branch
text: The transition `triage` has the output spec `Xor(fast, And(review, log))`. Its branches are numbered as the branch enumeration lists them: branch 0 is `{fast}`, branch 1 is `{review, log}`. Each firing deposits one token in every place of the branch it takes. There is no branch 2.

steps.text: Branch 1: one token each to `review` and `log`.
The spec has two branches, so branch 2 does not exist.
